notes.title: Release 2.3.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updated to the new logo in the main menu.
[*] Added a link to my next game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3832210/Kingdom_Conquer/]Kingdom Conquer[/url] in the menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.3.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Changed the movement system to no longer use forward/backwards input. This brings the controls back to the original concept of the game where you'll need to think of creative ways to slow down or speed up if required.
[*]Improved support for Ultrawide and trivial aspect ratios.
[*]Improved compression of assets resulting in ~40% smaller disc size and increased FPS.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.2.1
notes.content: Changed the party size limit in the main menu from 6 to 12.

notes.title: Update 2.2.0
notes.content:
Adjusted AI to be less difficult.

Increased the ambient brightness on tracks that were too dark to increase visibility of hazards.

notes.title: Localization Support!
notes.content:
- Localization support has been added for the following languages:
[list]
[*]Korean
[*]Japanese
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Russian
[*]French
[*]German
[*]Italian
[*]Spanish
[*]Portuguese
[/list]

- 32bit processor support has been discontinued due to this implementation of CJK characters.

notes.title: Update 2.0.3 / 2.0.4
notes.content:

notes.title: Update 2.0.2
notes.content:
[Multiplayer]
Fixed a multiplayer issue that was a result of splitscreen being added. (Thanks ４じょうきおと)

notes.title: First Major Content Update
notes.content:
The movement of animals has been drastically overhauled to provide a smoother yet more rewarding experience for those who can manage their speed and steering effectively. Along with this, animals can be overextended when sprinting, be it for strategy or if you haven't been paying attention and the longer you can maintain drifts for the more bonus adrenaline you will gain for boosting when you exit. We've also added a Speedster difficulty for those out there seeking more intense thrills.

The new Totem Cup grand prix was designed to showcase the new movement system, featuring new types of twists and turns that we haven't seen before that rewards higher skill manoeuvres. The cup will take you through a dirt rally in the outback, over the high bridges of bluffs, a spiral descent through a large volcano and the changing beaches of a tropical island.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33363558/208ae6ef70fc2f91ed5e01cde3f2721476eb25ad.jpg[/img]


And what better way to experience these changes than with splitscreen for up to 4 players! We're very proud to have implemented this feature and hope you get a lot of joy playing with others. You can set up custom keybindings and controllers for any type of setup from the Input menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33363558/a32fe5c120d54ff56a09b7d17e895b71160b8300.jpg[/img]


Finally, the Woolly Mammoth has been introduced as the first new animal! This big boy is the largest in the game by far and is able to run through obstacles without slowing down!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33363558/2acd232fbe06e254955e91ac6107f58f69631483.jpg[/img]

A full list of changes can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/773440/announcements/detail/1616140423562211463]here[/url].

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
[b]Features[/b]
New grand prix, Totem Cup.
New Mammoth clan.
Local split screen mode for up to 4 players.
New Speedster difficulty setting, the fastest in the game.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Updated sprint system.
New steering / drifting mechanics.
New accelerating / braking system.
Animals no longer collide.
Bots can no longer stack too many of the same clan.
Reduced timer in elimination mode.
Reduced Lizard's sun wall size.
The same map won't appear twice in a row in Wild Mix.
Reduced confusion durations.
Adjusted difficulty timer multipliers.
Giant mammoths added to Mammoth Mountain.

[b]UI[/b]
Fixed UI clipping in higher resolutions.
Ability icons shake when they become available.
Removed player status text in bottom left of screen.
New keybinding and controller configuration menu for up to 4 players.

[b]Video[/b]
Added screen darkening effect when close to danger.
Changed cliffs to red on Ferny Trail.
Improved colour grading.

[b]Audio[/b]
Added missing reverb zones to tracks.
Adjusted audible range of explosive abilities.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content: Online matchmaking will now be set to US regardless of user set region. Private lobbies are not affected.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]Misc[/b]
Fixed Time Trials thinking it was in Wild Mix mode. (Thanks Z-BOY).
Improved collisions of invisible walls in Alpine Maze.
Added more loading tips.

[b]Video[/b]
Improved UI layouts for 4:3 and 16:10 modes.
Walrus 'suck' particles fade out.

[b]Audio[/b]
Limited the player collision impact sound.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Misc[/b]
Added more respawn points for Alpine Maze.
Removed a small invisible wall on Outback Oasis.
Circuit tracks in Time Trials now have the same amount of laps as the multiplayer version rather than single player (less laps).

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
Members of your party's animals should now properly appear within the main menu.
Increased round time for Mushroom Madness.
Walrus slap particles should disappear properly.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Video[/b]
Grass details now shown on Lowest.
Depth of Field values tweaked.
Ultimate particles now fade out.

[b]Misc[/b]
Renamed Alpine Lake to Alpine Maze.
Restart Trial button added to Time Trails along with a hotkey (default: delete).
Leaderboard text has improved formatting.
Difference between player positions is now shown as distance in metres.
Unlocked text on experience screen now properly shows multiple messages.
Delay added to the end of a private game before returning to lobby.

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
Increased multiplayer round times for Sandy Circuit and Alpine Maze.
The random paths in Alpine Maze are now synced properly.
